name: security-deposit-portal
description: AICTE Security Deposit & FDR Lifecycle Management Portal

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
